_about: Layout rules of the video-only screens, in 1920x1080 design px. The one source of positions, sizes and times: py promo/layout_build.py writes layout.data.js from this file, layout.js turns it into CSS variables and coordinates, bgm.py reads the times. Units: x, y, w, h are design px (top-left origin); other lengths end in _px, times (from the start of the cut) end in _s. Keys starting with _ are notes. Values were read from the pages as they were on 2026-11-03.

subtitle_band._note: the bottom 170 px hold nothing but the subtitles

safe._note: side margin 96, top margin 60, down to the subtitle band

_min_text_note: smallest font size at 1080p, Japanese and Latin alike. A rule of this project, not taken from an outside standard.

colors._note: night: ground of the title screens; ink: black ink on paper; tile_*: the N05 test tiles

n00._duration_note: 8.6 s is N00's slot in narration draft 6 (0:00-0:08.6): the voice is the longer line that says what HIRAKU is (7.86 s from 0.3 s)

tagline.text: 作る前に、CAE で確かめる AI エージェント
tagline._note: added 2026-11-03: one line under the rule that says what HIRAKU is (the logo and the pets alone did not say it). Centred, ink-soft; bottom about 458 + 1.3 x 36 = 505, above pets.y

pets._note: added 2026-11-03: the ten 3D pets of promo/pets/pet3d.js (v7, packager = six-piece burr) in one row, in pet3d's ROLES order: lead, designer, packager, then the seven CAE domains in the order the chips light. Box i is w x h at y, centred on cx_i = 960 - span / 2 + w / 2 + i x pitch_px (+ group_gap_px from the fourth on), span = 9 x pitch_px + group_gap_px + w = 1708 (x 106 to 1814, inside safe). Each box is a 2D canvas: one WebGL renderer off the page (the size of one box) draws each pet alone and the frame is copied into that pet's canvas, so no pet reaches past its box

camera._note: every pet is seen the same way: a camera fitted to pet3d's FRAME box as promo/pets/viewer.html does (distance = max(FRAME.h / 2, FRAME.w / 2 / aspect) / tan(fov / 2) x 1.04 + 0.6), turned azimuth_deg about the vertical and raised elevation_deg

chip._note: the seven domain chips, centred under their pets. 27 px until 2026-11-03; 24 px (story body_text_px) so 強度信頼性 (about 178 px wide) clears its neighbours at pitch 168

tag._note: name tags of lead, designer and packager (no domain chip, never lit): thin faint border, ink-soft

motion._note: a domain's pet is idle until its chip lights at light_s + k x step_s, then does one pass hop (pass_dur_s) and stays in report (leans to tell). hop_period_s is pet3d.js's pass period (0.9 s, inside update; not exported): each CAE pet's clock is shifted so its hop starts from the ground when its chip lights. Lead, designer and packager stay idle, with clocks shifted by idle_shift_s x index so they do not blink together. The pose is pet.update(t + shift, state) with t from timeline.js only

times._note: name: first letter; tagline: the line under the rule fades in (0.6 s); row: pets, chips and tags come in, unlit (0.5 s; 1.1 s until 2026-11-03, moved for the tagline); light: first chip lights; step: gap between chips (light_s and step_s are read by bgm.py)

The app's render (web/js/cut.js) uses all of these; promo n05.html uses push_scale only (the vehicle grows to it until the door swings wide, then fades out by door.hero_fade_*); burst_scale, burst_dur_s and ease are not used there

gloss.text: CAE = コンピュータで設計を試す技術
gloss._note: added 2026-11-03: says in small type what CAE is, under the tag line, fading in at times.gloss_s. Bottom 244 + 1.2 x 24 = 272.8, above grid.y (280); the tag (bottom 186 + 1.2 x 42 = 236.4) and the name (58 to 182) moved up 14 and 4 px to make room (they were at 200 and 62)

times._gloss_note: added 2026-11-03: the small line under the tag (title.gloss) fades up over 0.6 s, 0.1 s after the tag starts
times._points_note: added 2026-11-03 (v5). points: the cloud of nodes starts to gather onto the vehicle (hero_points); hero_in: the vehicle's picture fades in over hero_points.hero_in_dur_s once the points have gathered (in by 0.46 s); points_out: the points fade over hero_points.fade_dur_s, handing over to the mesh lines (mesh_in_s). Before v5 the picture was there from 0 s
times._note: burst: flash of light as the door has swung out; tiles: first tile starts to fly in; tile_in: flight of one tile; tile_stagger: between tiles, nearest to fly_from first; door_open: the closed door starts to part (door.crack_*). burst, tiles, name and tag were 0.3 s earlier until 2026-11-03; they moved to leave the door closed a while first. latch: the bolt slides back and the leaves jolt (door.latch_*), the seam light flickers; mesh_in: the triangle mesh starts to show over the vehicle (hero_mesh.in_dur_s); mesh_out: its first elements come apart (hero_mesh.*)

door._v4_note: added 2026-11-03 (v4). crack_overshoot_deg: the crack runs past crack_deg by this much and settles back over settle_dur_s (inside hold_dur_s), so the leaves stop like heavy doors. latch_*: at times.latch_s the bolt (bolt: on the left leaf across the seam, w x h, reaching reach_px into the right leaf, sliding back travel_px, gap_px above the handle) slides back over latch_dur_s while both leaves jolt open by up to latch_deg and come to rest at 0.4 of it. thickness_px: the leaves' free edges, seen as they turn. dolly_px: from times.door_open_s to times.burst_s the door comes towards the viewer by this much (translateZ under perspective_px, dolly_ease), and the light in front of it grows by the same factor perspective / (perspective - dolly), so the view seems to pass through the door. The swing's own overshoot is not drawn: past about 60 deg the leaves are out of the frame
door._note: double door over the whole stage behind the vehicle, two leaves of 960 x 1080 hinged on the outer edges, opening towards the viewer (kannon-biraki; rotateY, perspective_px from the stage's centre). Closed until times.door_open_s while the light in the seam grows; then the leaves part by crack_deg over crack_dur_s (crack_ease), stay there for hold_dur_s, and swing on to angle_deg over open_dur_s (ease: slow at first, then fast as the leaves pass out of the frame, near 68 deg). Fully open (and hidden) at door_open_s + crack_dur_s + hold_dur_s + open_dur_s = times.burst_s. The vehicle in front does not open: from the start of the wide swing it grows from hero_motion.push_scale to hero_fade_scale and fades out over hero_fade_dur_s. seam_w_px / seam_glow_w_px: the warm light in the seam and its halo; spill_dur_s: the light behind the door, seen through the opening, and the light that spills towards the viewer, both fade out over it from the start of the wide swing. panel: the two raised panels on each leaf (inset from the leaf's edges, upper panel height, gap between the panels, outline width, width of the raised border); handle: the pull next to the seam

rays._note: shafts of light fanning out of the opening, from fly_from: count wedges, half to each side, each at a seeded angle within spread_deg of the horizontal and a seeded width (width_*_deg), length_px long, blurred by blur_px. From times.door_open_s they grow from crack_scale (squeezed towards the seam) and nothing to full width and peak_alpha at times.burst_s, then fade over out_dur_s. Each shimmers on its own seeded period (shimmer_*_dur_s). Seeded: the same seed gives the same shafts

dust._note: motes floating in the light: count soft dots at seeded places in a w x h ellipse around fly_from (seeded size_*_px), brighter near fly_from, each drifting up to drift_px and twinkling on its own seeded period. They come in over in_dur_s once the door has cracked (times.door_open_s + door.crack_dur_s) and fade over out_dur_s from times.burst_s

bloom._note: the light floods out as the door is fully open: a warm radial wash around fly_from rises over rise_dur_s to peak_alpha at times.burst_s and falls over fall_dur_s. 0.42 in the first stills washed the screen out with the shafts and the light behind the door; 0.3 keeps it from burning white

hero_mesh._note: the vehicle comes apart as a finite-element mesh. Triangles of side size_px (rows of nodes, every other row shifted half a side, each node moved by up to jitter x size_px, seeded) cover the hero box; their lines show only where the vehicle's picture is (the PNG's alpha as an SVG mask), line_px wide, fading in over in_dur_s from times.mesh_in_s. From times.mesh_out_s each element flares, shrinks to end_scale about its centre and vanishes over el_dur_s, taking its piece of the picture with it; an element starts spread_dur_s x min(1, distance from fly_from / reach_px) later, plus up to jitter_dur_s (seeded). The last ends by times.mesh_out_s + spread_dur_s + jitter_dur_s + el_dur_s, inside the swing's start + door.hero_fade_dur_s. Only with a picture (hero.src or ?hero=); the line drawing fades as before. size_px was 34 at first (about 2400 triangles, each drawn twice with its own animation): the same t shot twice then differed in 1 to 4 of 6 tries (headless Chromium had not finished painting); at 50 (about 1100) 24 of 24 tries were identical

mask._note: where the vehicle's picture is, cell by cell in the hero box (cols x rows cells of cell_px design px; the picture fitted in the box as the page draws it, contain). A cell is set when at least cover of its pixels have alpha above threshold. One hex string per row, the first column in the high bit of the first digit, padded to whole digits. Computed from src by hero_mask() in promo/tests/test_layout.py, which checks it against the PNG (the page cannot read the PNG's pixels: a file:// picture taints the canvas)

hero_points._note: the vehicle gathers from a cloud of nodes (v5): the points are the nodes of hero_mesh (same seed and rows, so they land where the mesh lines will run) that fall on a set cell of mask, plus points on the outline (set cells next to an unset one, each kept with outline_keep and moved by up to jitter x cell_px about the cell's centre, seeded). Each starts at a seeded place scatter_*_px from where it lands (margin_px inside the stage and above the subtitle band; a place outside is drawn again, so no points pile up on the edges), at start_alpha, and comes in over gather_dur_s (ease) after a seeded delay of up to stagger_s from times.points_s, growing to full brightness. dot_px / node_dot_px: radius of an outline point / a node. All are in by points_s + stagger_s + gather_dur_s = times.hero_in_s; then the picture fades in (times.hero_in_s, hero_in_dur_s) and the points fade from times.points_out_s over fade_dur_s. Only with a picture; the line drawing has no points

tile_fx._note: drawn in ?layer=fg too, so it moves exactly as the app's tiles (web/js/compose.js flyIn: same start, tile_in_s, ease.tile, fly_from and cells). ghosts: outlines that trail each tile by ghost_lag_s each, up to ghost_alpha, gone before the tile lands. Landing: a warm glow around the cell from the first moment the eased flight reaches its place (computed from ease.tile), over land_dur_s, land_glow_px wide

name_wipe._note: the name appears under a light that strokes it from left to right: from times.name_s a mask edge (feather_px soft) runs over the letters (their measured extent) in wipe_dur_s, with a warm band sweep_w_px wide on the edge; each letter is lit as the edge passes and cools to the ink of the night screen over afterglow_dur_s

depth._note: four cards in a row (4 x card_w + 3 x gap_px = w) in the order of a run: the areas, the tools, hand calculation set against analysis, fixed and passed. Each is a rule on top, a label, one figure with its unit and a line or two that says what it means; a small arrow (arrow_px) sits on the rule in each gap. Bottom 516 + 300 = 816

stamp._note: when the figures were counted, the git ref and the run, right-aligned, small; bottom 890, above the subtitle band

count._note: each figure counts up over its dur_s and stops on the counted value: steps whole numbers (value x ease(j / steps), rounded down; fewer when the value is smaller), one after another at even times, so every frame shows a whole number. in_dur_s: how long a card or caption takes to come in

times._note: amount: comes in with 構想は 10 万行 (0.30-1.93 s); the lines count up from amount_count_s and stop at amount_count_s + count.amount_dur_s = 1.65 s; the commits, days and tests come in at amount_sub_s. cards: with その道を、Claude Code が拓きました (2.28-5.01 s) the heading and the four cards come in card_step_s apart from cards_s (2.35, 2.75, 3.15, 3.55 s), each counting up over count.card_dur_s, the last stopping at 4.45 s. stamp: the counted-at line at 4.5 s. From 4.9 s to the end the picture holds still

light._note: centred. grow_dur_s: the thin line grows from times.line_s to its full height, ending at times.open_s (title.css grows it over 0.6 s; N18 sets its own since v2)

url._note: was at y 856 until v2; moved up 30 px to leave room for the credit under it

credit._note: one small line under the URL: HIRAKU Powered by Claude (no Claude logo, no Anthropic colours; the Agent SDK overview's branding guidelines list Claude Agent, Claude and {YourAgentName} Powered by Claude as allowed; this is the third form. It replaced Built with Claude on 2026-11-03: see promo/README.md). Unbleached ink (--on-night) at alpha, fading in over fade_dur_s from times.credit_s. Bottom about 892, above the subtitle band

gather._note: before the line (v2, after the reference's closing): count motes at seeded places in a w x h ellipse about (stage centre, cy), kept margin_px inside the stage and above the subtitle band, each of a seeded radius dot_*_px, are drawn in to seeded points on the line (x = stage centre, y within the light box, more towards its middle) over gather_dur_s (ease: slow, then fast) after a seeded delay of up to stagger_s from times.gather_s; they brighten from start_alpha and go out as they reach the line. A faint glow on the line's place rises to seed_glow_alpha meanwhile and hands over to the light at times.line_s. All motes are in by gather_s + stagger_s + gather_dur_s = times.line_s

name_bloom._note: the name comes up in a bloom of light (v2): each letter, as it rises (title.css letter-in), wears a warm glow (text-shadow) of peak_blur_px at peak_alpha, held for the first 30 % of settle_dur_s (while the letter fades in), that settles to rest_blur_px at rest_alpha by the end of settle_dur_s; behind the name a soft halo (halo_w x halo_h, centred on the name) rises to halo_peak_alpha at 45 % of settle_dur_s (as the last letters come in) and settles to halo_rest_alpha. The first stills had it peak at 18 % and 0.3: a bright patch ran ahead of the letters on the right

times._note: gather: motes gather onto the line's place (gather); line: thin vertical line grows (light.grow_dur_s); open: it opens into a band; draw: vehicle strokes start; credit: the small line under the URL; out: fade to black. line was 0.15 until v2 (2026-11-03): it moved to 0.4 to leave the motes time to gather first; open_s (read by bgm.py) and the order did not change

labels._note: small numbered labels over the opening quick looks N01-N04 (labels.html?cut=n01, or the entry pages labels_n01.html ... labels_n04.html), on a transparent ground over the app's cut. The cut's length is n01..n04.duration_s. A label comes in at times.in_s from the start of the cut over in_dur_s and is gone times.out_before_end_s before its end (fading over out_dur_s, ending then). Words follow the voice (narration draft 6)

box._note: bottom left, inside the lower-left corner of the cut's view or tile (they end at y 886 and start at x 96 in n01-n04), 16 px in from the left and 18 px above their bottom edge; bottom 868, above the subtitle band. The label is as wide as its words, up to w. At y 842 (first stills) it straddled the boxes' bottom border

story._note: What each cut must get across in about 3 seconds (one message), and how much it may show. The maker on 2026-11-03: the screens are too busy to come across in the demo. Counts are of things on screen at one time t; elements say what they are with data-kind (label, graph, legend, number, moving) so layout_check can count them. A cut's limits are the defaults unless it lists its own, each with a why.

defaults._note: label: name tags and ticks; graph: plots; legend: colour bars; number: emphasised figures; moving: things in motion at once; body_text_px: smallest size of text the viewer must read (the global min_text_px 18 stays for notes and sources)

band_exempt.why: authoring clock, drawn in the band with ?guides=1
N05's closed door covers the whole stage as the ground behind the vehicle until it opens (by n05.times.burst_s); it holds no text, and the subtitles are drawn over it

allow_overflow.why: line-height (1 to 1.3) is shorter than the font's content box (ascent + descent), so scrollHeight runs a few px past the line box. Measured 2-7 px (0.06-0.23 em). The glyphs stay inside and no ancestor clips them; a taller line-height would move the text

allow_escape.why: the caption fades up from 14 px below its place (0.6 s), so while it moves it reaches up to 14 px under the figure's box; at rest it is inside

allow_overlap.why: the before / after label sits inside the view's top left on purpose (n07.label)
the seek bar sits over the view's lower edge on purpose (n16.seek)
the vehicle is drawn over the vertical light on purpose
the vehicle stands in front of the closed door on purpose; it fades out as the door swings open
N08's dialogs, warnings and the stack of manuals pile up over one another and over the main window on purpose: the pile is the picture (too much to learn)
the planned 100,000 is drawn faint behind the lanes on purpose while they start to grow; it is gone (2.3 s) before the commits stream in
